notes.note: Blakey was one of 8 Swans over 100 with his 28 touches and 6 marks.
Solid from Blakey with 12 marks and 28 disposals. He is a good option as a back replacement for Milera if you need one.
24 touches and a goal for Blakey. He has had three good weeks in a row now and is going to be considered by anyone needing a defender replacement.

Blakey was able to get some of his run and carry back in this game but he was always under pressure which did impact him a little but 21 disposals and 630m gained was a good performance from him and he could be a handy replacement for Holmes in your team.
Blakey equal top scored for the Swans on the back of 21 kicks and 4 handballs. His best game in the last four weeks and he looked to have his free flowing running game back on track.
This makes it three weeks now under 100 for Blakey despite 21 kicks and 5 handballs this week. Hopefully he can turn this form around to where he was earlier in the season.
Blakey couldn't get his game going as he ended with 19 disposals and his second lowest score of the season. He will bounce back as he does have these down games once in a while.
22 kicks and 3 handballs for Blakey with this now making it three under 100 in the last four for the lizard. Having said that two are in the 90s and he is ok to hold.
Blakey was the setup man as we normally see him. 20 kicks with 6 handballs for him.
Blakey took advantage of the blow out to spend a big chunk of time on the bench towards the end of the game after racking up 28 disposals.
